event.value: The quarry is recognized as a Stoneborn sacred site.
The quarry is reopened for industrial mining — The Taking.
Miners carve and awaken the Hornblende Golem as a guardian of atonement.
The golem turns on the miners. Foreman Aldric orders evacuation. Seals are placed.
The three vein-seals begin to fail; something stirs beneath the rubble.
